body:
Adds `research/twin-evaluation`: evaluating a robot policy with a biased digital twin as a control variate. Unbiased whatever the twin's bias, exact variance, faithful (ρ=η) vs noise-free (ρ=√η) twin, worth-it cost threshold, and ranking under wrong-way twin bias. Stylised, pure Python, 7 tests. Updates README bullet and site/projects.json; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
